$comment: The performance-qualification protocol a model must pass to be approved for high-risk regulatory drafting. DRAFT until the system owner approves it: a PQ run against unapproved acceptance criteria cannot produce a PASS, by construction in server/eval/pq/pq-verdict.ts. Every criterion names where its value came from; none was chosen for this file.
title: Performance qualification of a model for high-risk regulatory drafting
basis: docs/LAUNCH_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md: 'Only models with a passed PQ against server/eval/rag/ and server/eval/doc-quality/ are approved for high-risk regulatory drafting.' No validation document defined drafting PQ criteria before this file: docs/validation/VMP-001 section 2 puts model PQ out of scope, and the registry cited docs/validation/PQ-CORTEX-001 PQ-007/008, which measure pathway-prediction accuracy and 'regulatory intuition' for a different product, not drafting.

generation.harness: server/eval/doc-quality/gold-tasks.json, generation tasks that carry an input; scored by server/eval/doc-quality/doc-quality-metrics.ts scoreGenerationTask
generation.criteriaSource: server/eval/doc-quality/README.md: '--min-coverage 0.85' (the documented CI gate), 'a hard fail on any forbidden/overclaim phrase', and '10+ tasks per docType' to make per-document-type accuracy publishable.

extraction.harness: server/eval/doc-quality/gold-tasks.json, extraction tasks that carry an input and expectedFields; the pinned model is asked directly by server/eval/pq/run-pq.ts (buildExtractionPrompt) and scored by doc-quality-metrics scoreExtractionTask. It is deliberately NOT routed through a per-document-type extraction service: that would measure the service and whichever model it selects, which is the attribution failure the rag component is still blocked on.

rag.notExecutableReason: Needs a populated corpus: ENABLE_CORPUS_INGESTION is not 'true', so the sweep is a no-op and retrieval scores 0 items (see ga-readiness-report 'Precedent corpus ingestion sweep'; unblock with `tsx scripts/ingest-corpus.ts`, verify with `node scripts/verify-rag-corpus.mjs`). This is the only remaining blocker and it is operational, not code: nothing further has to be built in this repository to make this component executable.
resolvedBlockers: 2026-09-28: 'ragQuery takes no model parameter, so a RAG run cannot be attributed to the model under qualification' — resolved. RagRetrievalParams.model -> RetrievalOptions.model -> the aiRouter.route call in queryWithGeneration now pins the generator, and run-eval.ts takes --model. Unset is unchanged behaviour, and the gateway still refuses an unapproved model on a high-risk task, so this is attribution and not an approval override (server/services/__tests__/aiProviderRouter-served-model.test.ts).

2026-09-28: 'its faithfulness judge is itself an unpinned model' — resolved. run-eval.ts takes --judge-model and refuses a run where --model and --judge-model name the same model, since a model cannot grade itself (server/eval/rag/__tests__/run-eval-attribution.test.ts).
rag.attributionGate: server/eval/rag/run-eval.ts pqAttributionGaps: a run is citable as qualification of a named model only when --model and --judge-model are both set and differ. A run missing either prints 'NOT usable as PQ evidence' with the reason. It deliberately does not change the exit code — passing --min-hit-rate/--min-faithfulness is a separate question from being attributable, and conflating them would let a green regression run read as a PQ pass.
